proofs.race_free:
by
  refine ⟨(runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
    (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()))).getD
    (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ())), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · decide
proofs.segment_equivalence:
by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨(runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel (flatten segments)
    (initial layout input outside)).getD (initial layout input outside), ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rfl
  · decide
  · rfl
